mentions.name: SportWarzSim
mentions.description: This app simulates sports fandom on a map, modeling scenarios like franchise expansion and relocation. It is built as a set of Jupyter notebooks served via Voila, with a more interactive notebook included, runs on free-tier hosting, and can also be run locally via Docker. The name hints at a possible future as a simulation game.
mentions.source_excerpt: An exercise in simulating sports fandom on a map. To do things like simulate expansion and relocation of franchises.
